name: Baked Methi Muthia
category: Healthy Indian Snacks and Street Food
ingredients: 1 cup fresh methi leaves, finely chopped
½ tsp each turmeric, coriander powder and ajwain
½ tsp mustard seeds and 1 tsp sesame seeds (omit sesame for seed allergies)
steps: Mix the besan, wheat flour, methi, yogurt, paste, spices, 1 tsp oil, lemon and salt into a soft dough, adding a few tablespoons of water if needed.
Shape into two logs and steam for 15 minutes until firm. Cool, then cut into slices.
Arrange the slices on a tray and bake at 200°C for 12 minutes.
Heat the remaining oil, crackle the mustard seeds, and toss the muthia in it for 2 minutes.
note: A Gujarati snack that is normally fried; steaming and baking keep it light.
